scripts.mac:installer: npm run export:web && npm run mac:icons && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.json
scripts.win:installer: npm run export:web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.json
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run mac:release && npm run win:installer
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run export:web && npm run mac:icons && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.json --publish always
scripts.release:all: npm run desktop:installer && npm run ios:publish && npm run android:apk && npm run release:collect
scripts.beta:mac: npm run export:web && npm run mac:icons && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.json -c.extraMetadata.version=$(node scripts/beta-version.js) -c.appId=com.gentoo.app.beta -c.productName="Gentoo Beta" -c.extraMetadata.productName="Gentoo Beta" -c.artifactName='Gentoo-Beta-${version}-${os}-${arch}.${ext}' -c.mac.notarize=true --publish always
scripts.beta:win: npm run export:web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.json -c.extraMetadata.version=$(node scripts/beta-version.js) -c.appId=com.gentoo.app.beta -c.productName="Gentoo Beta" -c.extraMetadata.productName="Gentoo Beta" -c.artifactName='Gentoo-Beta-${version}-${os}-${arch}.${ext}' --publish always
scripts.beta:mac:installer: MAC_APP_ID=com.gentoo.app.beta MAC_PRODUCT_NAME="Gentoo Beta" MAC_VERSION=$(node scripts/beta-version.js) bash scripts/build-signed-mac.sh
scripts.beta:win:installer: npm run export:web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.json -c.extraMetadata.version=$(node scripts/beta-version.js) -c.appId=com.gentoo.app.beta -c.productName="Gentoo Beta" -c.extraMetadata.productName="Gentoo Beta" -c.artifactName='Gentoo-Beta-${version}-${os}-${arch}.${ext}' --publish never
scripts.beta:installer: npm run beta:mac:installer && npm run beta:win:installer
